correctness.rationale: The binary cut matrix has (P^-2)(I+P)^3 form, giving exactly the three-dimensional even-parity 4-periodic kernel. The quotient class independence criterion follows from its orthogonal complement. The independent-column rank update lemma handles all residue-mismatched cases; the dependent case is resolved by explicit Bx=e_0+e_d and an exact scalar kernel count distinguishing short and long omitted links. Direct standard-library GF(2) rank elimination matched 8,448 complete configurations for n=4,8,...,64, with all initial ranks correct. Finite checks corroborate but do not replace the infinite proof. The nonstandard algebraic steps are fully written in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: Third powers of even cycles are a natural finite-range qubit graph-state resource with two distinct cross-boundary edge lengths. The theorem classifies all two-omission placements with different even endpoints on an infinite family. The structurally unexpected exact cancellation versus one- and two-bit gains is useful for diagnosing entanglement sensitivity to missing entangling operations and cannot be obtained from a generic rank-two bound or the pristine circulant rank alone. The restriction 4|n is motivated by the nontrivial 3-dimensional cyclic kernel, not chosen to optimize a numerical experiment.
